note: The bands the Timber plant has to land in, from docs/TIMBER-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for the E-flite Turbo Timber Evolution 1.5 m and the drawn model (scripts/timber-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Cub's in proportion about its derived figure unless its source says otherwise. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

t1_cruise.source: level speed at 75 percent throttle, flaps up, slats on: derived 20.71. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7.5 three blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/timber-derive.js): was 17.97 on the straight line, the band 15.5 to 20.8 re-centred in the same proportion, 0.863 to 1.157 of the derived figure. Re-derived 2026-10-11 again with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool, scripts/lib/propcurve.js electricN): the derivation had flown the stick as the prop's speed share, which the plant has not held since its motor law changed; derived 21.46, was 20.71; the same 0.863 to 1.157 of it Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 22.69, was 21.46; the same 0.863 to 1.157 of it.

t2_stall_slats.source: power off, the nose raised slowly, flaps up, slats on: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax) with CLmax 1.455 is 7.20, and the plant's blended lift at the stall alpha, half linear and half flat plate, 8.73; the band is 0.94 of the one to 1.02 of the other. alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.455 / 5.25, of the zero lift line Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.838 (scripts/timber-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 5.25: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.27714. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.455 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.117, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.455 / 1.572) = 0.9622.

t3_stall_no_slats.source: the same without the slats, CLmax 1.15: 8.10 and 9.79; slower than T2's by the slats, which is the ordering gated Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.838 (scripts/timber-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 5.25: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.21905. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.150 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.094, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.150 / 1.244) = 0.9614.

t4_stall_full_flap.source: the same with full flaps and the slats, CLmax 1.894: 6.31 and 7.92; slower than T2's. alphaStall is (CLmax - the flaps' lift) / CLalpha, of the zero lift line Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.838 (scripts/timber-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 5.25: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.26747. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.894 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.113, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.894 / 2.007) = 0.9714.

t5_slowest.source: full flaps and slats, power on, height held on the throttle and speed on the elevator while the speed asked for comes down: the slowest level flight with alpha a blend short of the stall, where lift and the thrust's vertical share carry the weight at full throttle, derived 6.21; the wings held within 10 deg on the ailerons the whole way. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7.5 three blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/timber-derive.js): was 6.29 on the straight line, the band 5.7 to 7.2 re-centred in the same proportion, 0.906 to 1.145 of the derived figure Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 6.22 (flaps full, slats, 0.995 of full throttle), was 6.21; the same 0.907 to 1.143 of it.

t6_roll.source: full aileron from level at full throttle, as the helix angle: Clda da / -Clp, 0.391 x 30 deg / 0.806, derived 0.254 (280 deg/s at 15 m/s); the Cub's band in proportion

t7_flap_pitch.source: one step at level flight, 13 m/s, flaps full against flaps up at the same alpha and stick: the flaps' own pitching moment, nose up, derived 0.046 (the tail downwash factor from 1.25 to 1.75 gives 0.025 to 0.067), and their lift, derived 0.489 within 15 percent

t8_flap_mix.source: level at 65 percent in Manual, the sticks frozen, the flaps lowered to full: with the manual's down elevator mix the nose rises less than half as far in 4 s as it does with the mix taken out by the stick; the mix is 6.0 deg at full flap where holding the trim at the same lift wants 6.8, pass or fail

t9_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, 11.81 deg and 0.2117 m, 12.8 percent on the tail

t10_takeoff_full.source: full throttle on grass from standing, full flaps, the stick forward to bring the tail up to 9 deg: the tail lifts at 5.8 m/s and it flies at 7.04 m/s after 2.00 m. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7.5 three blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/timber-derive.js): was 2.22 m on the straight line, the distance band 1.6 to 3.2 re-centred in the same proportion, 0.721 to 1.441 of the derived figure; the speed band is the liftoff's and does not move Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 2.01 m, was 2.0; the distance band the same 0.725 to 1.440 of it, the speed band the liftoff's.

t11_takeoff_up.source: the same with the flaps up: 7.91 m/s after 2.52 m; the full flap roll is 0.79 of it, gated under 0.9. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7.5 three blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/timber-derive.js): was 7.90 m/s after 2.81 m on the straight line, the distance band 2.05 to 4.1 re-centred in the same proportion, 0.730 to 1.459 of the derived figure; the speed band and the ratio do not move Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 2.53 m, was 2.52; the distance band the same 0.730 to 1.456 of it, the speed band the liftoff's.

t12_landing.source: a full flap approach, flared and held off, touching down on three points with the throttle closed and the stick held back, the manual's grass landing: rolls 19.0 m from 7 m/s to rest on the grass's rolling resistance and the stalled wing's drag, there being no brakes; at rest on three wheels at T9's attitude, no hull or prop

t13_taxi.source: full right rudder at walking pace: wheelbase / tan(steer), 0.714 / tan 27 deg, derived 1.40, turning right: the rudder steers on the ground. The duty is the one that taxis the turn at walking pace, 1.4 m/s (docs/ON-FOOT.md, Bohannon 1997): 0.24 turns it at 1.41 m/s on the plant. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 11 x 7.5 three blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): it was 0.2685, the one that turns the prop at 0.3 of full as the gate was first written with 0.3 on the stick, which on the straight line taxied at 1.86 to 1.90 m/s and on the curve's stronger thrust at 1.99, past a walk; there the wash over the full rudder skids the tail round, 0.95 m, and by 0.30 it pivots at 0.25 m, so the premise the gate states, walking pace, is what sets the duty. The band does not move Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, 3.750, through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): at taxi the current is small and the pack barely sags, so 0.24 now turns the prop faster and taxis the turn at 1.95 m/s, past a walk, where the wash skids the tail round (1.09 m); 0.22 taxis it at 1.42 m/s on the plant, radius 1.29, as 0.24 did (1.42, 1.29). The band does not move.

t14_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and every other aircraft's recorded flight hash in Node, all from main's module before the Timber existed (cf9773d). Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky, cub, glider, bramor, bramorChute each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged The Radian's re-recorded again for crash round 5 on the lead's decision to take its 6 deg FITTED washout (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md), not on an owner's flight: its recording first differs at 7.778 s, in the stall (npm run stall:crossing). Every recorded flight re-recorded again for aero round 6's fix, the table's rotary derivatives applied in the stability axes, one commit per recording from that build, on the owner's approval of the fix on 2026-09-26: each moves short of the stall as well (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, Round 6). The fixed wings' hashes were re-recorded on 2026-09-27 when their packs and tanks began to drain, the owner's decision (docs/POWER-STAGE1.md); the five inch's is unchanged. Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was.

t15_cross_host.source: the Timber's recorded take off on half flaps and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
